viewDistanceHint: Makhalidwe otsika omwe amalimbikitsidwa pazida zotsika
maxPowerModeDesc: Amagwiritsa ntchito RAM yonse komanso mtunda wautali wopereka. Zingayambitse kutentha.
mobSpawningDesc: Amachepetsa kuchuluka kwa mabungwe kuti agwire bwino ntchito
forceExternalJvmDesc: Gwiritsani ntchito JVM yakunja m'malo mwa yophatikizidwa
openFolderDesc: Sakatulani mafayilo a seva muwoyang'anira mafayilo anu
managePluginsDesc: Sinthani mapulagini oyika ndi mapaketi azinthu
noModsInstalled: Palibe ma mods omwe adayikidwa pano
noResourcePacksInstalled: Palibe mapaketi azinthu omwe adayikidwa pano
useAddButton: Gwiritsani ntchito batani la Add kuti mulowetse fayilo, kapena yikani imodzi kuchokera pazenera.
deleteConfirmDesc: Izi zimachotsa fayilo ku mtundu waposachedwa wa seva.
pluginsTip: Kwezani mapulagini a Bukkit/Spigot/Paper a .jar. Pezani mapulagini pa spigotmc.org kapena hangar.papermc.io
tapToAddPlugin: Dinani 'Add Plugin' kuti mukweze fayilo ya .jar
noInternetConnection: Palibe intaneti. Chonde onani maukonde anu.
hubModLoaderRequired: Mod loader yofunikira pa ma mods
hubModLoaderDesc: Mtundu wa sevawu sukugwiritsa ntchito chojambulira chothandizira. Sinthani seva iyi kukhala Fabric kapena Quilt kuti muyike ma mods.
hubSectionDownloadedDesc: Sinthani zomwe zasungidwa kale pa seva iyi.
hubSectionDiscoverDesc: Zotsatira zapaintaneti zokha ndizomwe zikuwonetsedwa apa. Zofananira zomwe zidayikiridwa zimayikidwira inu.
hubNoOnlineResults: Palibe pa intaneti %s chofanana ndi kusakiraku.
hubDeleteDesc: Izi zichotsa fayiloyi ku mtundu wa seva iyi.
hubSearchRetry: Zosaka zimasungidwa ndipo zimakhala ndi malire, kotero kuyesanso kwakanthawi kumagwira ntchito.
hubDetailApplyDesc: Yambitsaninso seva mutasintha mapulagini kapena mapaketi.
worldsSlotHint: Pitani kumanzere kuti mufufute. Maiko omwe akugwira ntchito amatha kuchotsedwa pokhapokha seva itayimitsidwa.
worldsImportGuideDesc: Dinani kuti muwone momwe dziko ndi miyeso yochokera kunja imagwirira ntchito.
worldsResetDesc: Sankhani zomwe mukufuna kuchotsa. Mapulagini, mods, config owona, ndi server.properties adzasungidwa.
worldsResetRowWorld: Zikwatu zapadziko lonse lapansi (dziko, dziko_pansi, dziko_kumapeto)
worldsResetRowPlayers: Zambiri za osewera (playerdata, ziwerengero, kupita patsogolo)
worldsResetPreserved: Zosungidwa nthawi zonse: mapulagini/, mods/, config/, server.properties, ndi config owona.
worldsRestoreDesc:
Izi zibwezeretsanso: 
 - Zapadziko lonse lapansi ndi kukula 
 - Mapulagini, ma mods, ndi zida zapaketi 
 - Zochunira za seva 
 
 Mafayilo anu a seva alembetsedwa. 
 Onetsetsani kuti seva yayimitsidwa musanabwezeretse.
worldsDeleteWorldActive: Chotsani %s ? PocketCraft iyamba kupita kudziko lina lopulumutsidwa.
worldsImportGuideText1: Kutumiza kunja kwa Aternos kumatha kukwezedwa ngati ma ZIP atatu osiyana: Overworld, Nether, ndi The End.
worldsImportGuideText2: Zambiri zosunga zosunga zobwezeretsera zapadziko lonse lapansi zili kale ndi miyeso yonse munkhokwe imodzi, kotero kubweza kamodzi kwapadziko lonse ndikokwanira.
filesSeedDialogDesc: Lowetsani mbewu yadziko lanu. Siyani dziko lopanda kanthu.
filesDeleteWorldDesc: Izi zichotseratu %s ndikusintha kupita kudziko lina lopulumutsidwa ngati liripo.
onboardingWelcomeTitle:
Foni yanu tsopano ndi 
 seva ya game server
onboardingWelcomeSubtitle:
Host Java Edition ma seva aulere. 
 Palibe PC yofunika. Sewerani ndi aliyense.
onboardingStep1Body: Pepala limayenda kwanuko pafoni yanu ndikugwiritsa ntchito kukumbukira komwe muli nako.
onboardingStep2Body: PocketCraft imakupatsani adilesi yapadera yolumikizirana yomwe anzanu angalumikizeko.
onboardingStep3Body: Osewera a Java Edition amalumikizana molunjika kudzera pamasewerawa ndi kukangana kochepa.
onboardingImportSubtitle: Bweretsani dziko lanu, mapulagini, ndikusintha nanu. Palibe kuyambanso.
onboardingImportWorldBody: Tumizani kunja kuchokera ku Aternos, tsitsani zosungidwa mu PocketCraft, ndi kupitiriza.
onboardingImportPluginsBody: Gwiritsaninso ntchito mafayilo omwewo a .jar. Pulogalamu yanu yowonjezera imayenda ndi inu.
onboardingImportConfigBody: seva.properties, whitelist, ndi mwayi wogwiritsa ntchito zimakhalabe.
onboardingFeaturesSubtitle: Osati pulogalamu yovumbulutsidwa. Ili ndiye zida zenizeni za seva.
onboardingCrossPlaySubtitle: PocketCraft imathandizira masewera a Java ndi Bedrock pamene mlatho ndiwoyatsidwa pakukhazikitsa seva yanu.
onboardingCrossPlayJavaBedrockBody: Anzanu pa PC ndi mafoni amatha kujowina dziko lomwelo limodzi kudzera pa relay.
onboardingCrossPlayNoExtraAppBody: Gawani adilesi yanu ya seva ndipo osewera atha kulumikizana kuchokera ku mtundu wawo nthawi yomweyo.
onboardingCrossPlayExperimental:
⚠️ Zoyeserera - Sewerani Zomwe Mukufuna 
 
 Sewero losiyanasiyana likupangidwabe. Ziphuphu ndi kusasunthika zitha kuchitika chifukwa gawoli silinathandizidwe. Gwiritsani ntchito mwakufuna kwanu.
onboardingRegionSubtitle: Sankhani seva yolumikizira yomwe ili pafupi kwambiri ndi osewera anu. Mutha kusintha izi pambuyo pake kuchokera pa dashboard.
onboardingPermissionsSubtitle: Izi zimagwiritsidwa ntchito ngati seva, kuchuluka kwa osewera, ndi zosintha zofunika zakumbuyo pomwe seva yanu ikuyenda.
onboardingPermissionsCardBody: Imawonetsa mawonekedwe a seva ndi kuchuluka kwa osewera pomwe seva ikuyenda.
onboardingPermissionsStatusWarn: Kufikira zidziwitso ndikofunikira pa sitepe iyi. Dinani batani pamwambapa, ndikuloleza mu Android.
onboardingPermissionsStatusTap: Dinani batani pamwambapa, kenako vomerezani chilolezo cha Android kuti mutsegule Next.
onboardingGoogleSubtitle: Lowani tsopano kuti mutsegule zosunga zobwezeretsera zachinsinsi za Google Drive. Mutha kudumpha izi ndikumaliza kukhazikitsa kaye.
onboardingGoogleStatusDesc: Zosunga zobwezeretsera zimasungidwa mufoda yanu yachinsinsi ya Google Drive. PocketCraft sangathe kuwona kapena kupeza mafayilo anu ena pa Drive.
onboardingGoogleConnectedDesc: Ma seva anu, mapulagini, ndi makonda azisunga zokha ku: %s
onboardingSetupBackupNotice: Mutha kubwezeretsa zosunga zobwezeretsera zapadziko lonse pambuyo pake mu Zikhazikiko nthawi iliyonse yomwe mwakonzeka.
